data.name: Lagss
data.description:
Lagss (ラグス Ragusu) is a loyal member of the Core Area Warriors and one of the antagonists of the Universal Conflict Saga, before she allies with Goku and Vegeta to defeat Majin Ozotto in the Demon Invader Saga.

Name: Lagss
Alias: Rags
Appears in: Dragon ball heroes 
Manga Debut: "Universal Conflict"
Anime Debut: "I'll Settle This!! Into Operation! Ultra Instinct!"
Game Debut: Dragon Ball Heroes
Race: Glass People
Gender: Female
Allegiance: Core Area Warriors

Appearance: Lagss is a humanoid female with pale-blue skin and long pale turquoise hair tied in two ponytails with grey and gold hair bands and turquoise eyes. She wears a blue dress with a turquoise collar with gold trimmings, with matching golden trims on the side below her breasts and by her waist, which narrowly exposes the sides of her breasts. In the anime, she also has unattached sleeves with the same gold trimmings as the others, but in the game and manga, her sleeves are turquoise. She also has white boots with matching golden trims, blue soles, and dark blue-turquoise tights. She has her grey armbands and purple gloves with gold trims.

Personality: In her brief appearance, Lagss exhibits a ruthless nature, after wearing out Ultra Instinct Sign Goku, she mercilessly attacks the exhausted Saiyan with her glass shards.

Lagss is shown to be very loyal to Hearts, as she obeyed his command to go assist Cumber in Universe 3 (albeit with some reluctance). When Oren questioned Hearts' plan while they were still in the Core Area, Lagss threatened Oren with her Glass Bullet - stating that Hearts' ambition was her reason for living. Her devotion to Hearts was further shown when she prevented Zamasu from betraying him and shielded him and gave him the completed Universe Seed when he was at disadvantage against Jiren.

Lagss is a smart and pragmatic individual as she chooses to attack and neutralize her foes without giving them the chance to counterattack or recover and was able to foresee Zamasu's betrayal.

Biography: Super Dragon Ball Heroes
Prison Planet Saga
Main article: Prison Planet Saga
Universe Disturbance
Lagss and her allies appear

Lagss along with the other members of the Core Area Warriors make an appearance after the chains surrounding the Prison Planet have broken and the planet is on the verge of destruction. After Fused Zamasu retrieves Cumber's unconscious body, Lagss and the others teleport away.

Universal Conflict Saga
Main article: Universal Conflict Saga
Glass Barrage 3
Lagss outside of her barrier

In the anime, when Hearts summons Lagss on Universe 11 so that he can use her power, she appears within a barrier of glass. Hearts attempts to use his gravitational powers to force the pointed end of the barrier towards Goku though he is able to expend all his might in his Ultra Instinct Sign form in destroying it though he reverts to his normal state afterward. Lagss, now out of the barrier, sends the broken pieces of the barrier towards Goku which severely injures him and causes him to fall. Before she could finish the weakened Saiyan, Lagss was interrupted by Future Trunks, whom she fights against. Lagss prepares an attack on Trunks, but Goku pushes him out of the way, taking the attack and being wounded. She is soon told by Hearts to help Cumber in Universe 3. In Universe 3, Lagss is defeated by Meta-Cooler who almost finishes her off before Cumber intervenes.

SDBH11-3
Lagss' Glass Dragon

In the manga, in the Core Area, Lagss is asked by Hearts to fix Cumber who have been injured during his battle with Goku. Lagss and Kamin arrive in Universe 3 to find the Universal Release Device for Hearts and Lagss easily defeats Narirama, Nigrissi and Catopesra by turning them and the entire city into glass. She and Kamin appear in Universe 11 to give Hearts the device and interfere in the battle but is soon challenged by Dyspo. Lagss then intercepts Fused Zamasu when he attempts to claim the Universe Seed for himself and turns him into glass. Lagss appears in Universe 7, creating a Glass Dome around herself and Hearts from Jiren. She tells Hearts about the current situation regarding the other members of the Core Area Warriors and shows him the now-completed Universe Seed. She delivers the Universe Seed to Hearts transforms him into Perfect Hearts. Lagss intercepts Piccolo and Android 17 when they attempt to join the others and uses a Glass Dragon that fires a powerful blast that seemingly takes down Piccolo while Android 17 defends himself with his Android Barrier. However, she is caught off guard when Piccolo appears and destroys the dragon with his Special Beam Cannon and while distracted, Android 17 attacks Lagss from behind and finishes her off with his Super Electric Strike.

An injured Lagss prepares to head over to assist Hearts, but Majin Ozotto suddenly appears from a whirl of darkness and absorbs her with the black smoke, obtaining the powers of the glass tribe for himself before vanishing.

Demon Invader Saga
Main article: Demon Invader Saga
In the anime, Lagss uses her glass shards to save Goku and Vegeta, who had just freed Gohan from his absorption chamber, from tentacle-like appendages that begin to wrap around them. She and Hearts assists them against Majin Ozotto's clones and shreds them with Glass Bullet. She joins in the conversation with Hearts, Goku and Vegeta to discuss about how to escape Ozotto's Palace. Lagss and Hearts then battle a horde of Ozotto's clones while Vegeta uses Full Power Final Explosion to shatter space-time creating a vortex to escape the palace. Lagss and Hearts escape Ozotto's Palace with Goku's absorbed comrades out with them while Goku battles the transformed Ozotto. After Goku defeats Ozotto, Lagss and the others are sent back to their Space-Time by Super Shenron.

In the manga, after Hearts learns from Ozotto that he has absorbed Lagss, Hearts intentionally allows himself to be eaten to seek her out and rescue her. After Lagss is rescued by Hearts, they saved Goku, Vegeta and Gohan from the legion of Ozotto clones and work together, using their gravity cubes and glass shards respectively to defeat the horde of clones in a near instant. Lagss covered all the walls in glass, so it can't summon more Ozotto's clones. After Vegeta uses Full Power Final Explosion to shatter space-time creating a vortex, Lagss, Hearts and everyone else are freed from the Ozotto's Palace. After escaping the Ozotto's Palace, Lagss and the others see the giant form of Ozotto who has been in a deep sleep ever since. However, dozens of Ozotto clones suddenly appear with many of them transforming into familiar villainous faces. Lagss and the group prepares to fight the Ozotto's clones. She saves Yamcha, who thought she was Vidro, from an Ozotto clone. When giant Ozotto wakes up and attempts to absorb everyone again, Lagss and Hearts encase Goku and Xeno Goku in a combined Glass Gravity Cage, saving them from being absorbed along with the others. Inside Ozotto's body, Lagss and Hearts, along with the Time Patrol, have set free all of those with regenerative abilities, thus robbing Ozotto of that ability in turn. After Goku defeats Ozotto, Lagss and the others, except the Time Patrol, are sent back to their rightful history by Shenron.

Power: Anime
By propelling her glass structure at Ultra Instinct Sign Goku while Hearts utilized Gravity Burst, the duo were able to pressure Goku until he finally reverted to base form, upon which, Lagss effortlessly defeated a worn out Goku with a barrage of glass shards. However, Lagss met her match against Super Saiyan Future Trunks, who was able to stop her Glass Bullets and then fly through a barrage of them, proceeding to drive her back with an energy wave.

She is also shown to have been no match against Meta-Cooler.

Manga
She is able to cover a large part of a planet in Universe 3 in glass, restraining the likes of Narirama, Nigrissi and Catopesra in the process. Using her Shield Mirror she is able to stop an attack by Super Saiyan God Vegeta. She and Dyspo battle evenly thanks to their distinct abilities. She is able to fight both Android 17 and Piccolo at the same time but is outsmarted by their strategy and defeated.

Using her Glassification, she is able to turn Fused Zamasu into glass, he retains his consciousness while like this, but is unable to act.

Techniques and Special Abilities: Flight - The ability to fly through the use of ki.
Ki Blast - The most basic form of energy wave.
Glass Manipulation - As a member of the Glass Tribe, Lagss has the innate ability to manipulate and control glass for various purposes.
Glassification[8] - Lagss can cover things in glass or turn things into glass. She can do this to injured people to restore them (as she did with Cumber) or to restrain foes (as she did to Universe 3's fighters).
Glass Generation[8] - Lagss can create glass at will. By touching the ground, she can generate sharp pillars of glass from it.
Glass Molding - Lagss manipulates her glass to form objects.
Float Mirror - Lagss creates a mirror to deflect attacks.
Glass Dome - Lagss creates a large, spiked glass construct to hide within.
Glass Pod - Lagss creates a working glass Attack Ball.
Glass Dragon - Lagss' ultimate technique, she creates a massive dragon resembling Shenron out of glass which she uses to fight.
Glass Energy Wave - The Glass Dragon fires an energy wave infused with glass at the foe.
Glass Bullet - Lagss fires shards of glass at her enemies.
Glass Barrage - Lagss fires a barrage of glass shards at her opponent. She flick her index and middle fingers upward to have her glass shards strike her opponent from behind.
Teleportation - Lagss possesses the ability to teleport herself and her glass structure.

Equipment: Glass - In the anime, Lagss possesses a massive glass object she can freely manipulate (including for travel purposes). It was shattered by Ultra Instinct Sign Goku.

Battles
Super Dragon Ball Heroes
Manga: Lagss and Oren vs. Vegeta (Super Saiyan God)
Lagss vs. Narirama and Nigrissi (Flashback)
Lagss and Kamioren vs. Vegeta (Super Saiyan God/Super Saiyan Blue)
Lagss vs. Dyspo
Lagss vs. Piccolo and Android 17
Lagss vs. Majin Ozotto
Lagss and Hearts vs. Majin Ozotto (Clones)
Lagss vs. Majin Ozotto (Zangya) (Clone)
Lagss and Yamcha vs. Majin Ozotto

Anime: Lagss vs. Goku (Ultra Instinct Sign/Base)
Lagss vs. Future Trunks (Super Saiyan)
Lagss vs. Cooler (Meta-Cooler)
Lagss vs. Three Majin Ozottos (Clone)

Trivia: Lagss' name is an anagram of the word "Glass".

character_book.name: Dragon Ball Lorebook
character_book.description: This is to go even further beyond!

entries.name: Ki (Fundamental) - Important
entries.content: Ki is also known as 'latent energy' or 'fighting power,' which directly translates as 'life force.' This force is a tangible energy inside every living being, with its major focus being in the center of the body. By drawing it out, an individual is able to manipulate it and use it outside the body. Ki can be used for many different techniques. Because there are physical limits to the strength of the body itself, it is necessary to increase one's ki to overcome this barrier and become stronger. Usually, the more concentrated the masses are, the more time the user requires to draw it out by powering up

entries.name: God Ki (Ki)
entries.content: God Ki is a special type of ki used by godly beings. Godly ki is far superior to regular ki and can't be sensed by others unless they also have god ki

entries.name: Multiverse (World)
entries.content: The Dragon Ball multiverse, or the Dragon Ball world, is the chain of universes within the Dragon Ball series. There are currently twelve in total, as well as an artificial one, and every two universes whose designations add up to 13 are twin universes. Each universe is governed by a Supreme Kai and God of Destruction, who act to balance creation and destruction. The entirety of the multiverse is ruled by Zeno. Formerly, there were 18 universes in total, but Zeno erased 6 of them when he was angry

entries.name: Zeno (Character)
entries.content: Grand Zeno ('King of All'), the Omni-King, is the supreme ruler of all the Multiverse and seemingly its most powerful being

entries.name: Grand Minister (Character)
entries.content: The Grand Minister ('Daishinkan'), formally Grand Priest to the Omni-King(s), is an Angel serving as a close adviser and guiding figure to Zeno and Future Zeno. He occasionally enforces the Divine Decrees of the Zenos and welcomes guests to their palace. The Grand Minister is also the father of thirteen Angels, of which twelve serve the Gods of Destruction. Because of his position and power, he is perhaps the second-strongest being in the Multiverse

entries.name: Angel (Race)
entries.content: The Angels are life-forms of extremely high status within the hierarchy of the multiverse. Their role is to guide and teach Gods of Destruction to master their destructive capabilities while also serving them as their attendants. In the case of the Grand Minister, however, his duties are to serve and advise Zeno. As deities, they possess god ki. Angels do not need for food, though they can eat and drink as a luxury. They also do not need sleep, unlike Gods of Destruction and Supreme Kais

entries.name: God of Destruction (Role)
entries.content: The Gods of Destruction (Hakaishin'), are very powerful deities who destroy planets, races, or threats that put the development of their respective universes at risk, as opposed to the Supreme Kais, the Gods of Creation, who create and fill planets with life, to maintain the balance of the universe. Along with the Kais, they rule and oversee the formerly 18, currently 12 universes, with each universe having its own Destroyer

entries.name: Supreme Kai (Role)
entries.content: The Supreme Kais ('Kaiōshin'), also known as the Creation Gods, are the Core People who are naturally born divine and who have the ultimate duty to protect the universe of their position. Along with the Gods of Destruction, they are the ruling and overseeing class of the twelve, formerly eighteen, universes, and each universe has its own set of gods

entries.name: King Kai (Character)
entries.content: King Kai is the North Kai and king of Universe 7's North Area. He became a Kai and went on to live on his own planet located at the end of the Snake Way in the Other World. There, he lives with a monkey named Bubbles and a motor-mouth grasshopper named Gregory, and he spends his time counting the blades of grass, contemplating the heavens, riding his Red 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air Hardtop, and seeing how far he can pee. On his planet, he teaches powerful techniques such as the Spirit Bomb and Kaio-ken to those who visit him

entries.name: Other World (Location)
entries.content: Other World, also called the Underworld, Other Side, the Cosmos, Next Dimension, Oblivion, or Netherworld, is the afterlife in the Dragon Ball series. It is where characters go when they die, and also where the higher deities of the universe reside. It also exists in other universes. Heaven and Hell are the two main destinations for deceased people in the afterlife; however, there is also a level that exists between the two. This level contains the personal planets of deities such as King Kai and Grand Kai, as well as the celestial bureaucracy who are in charge of running the day-to-day activities of Other World, such as King Yemma

entries.name: Dragon Team (Role)
entries.content: The Dragon Team, also known as the Z Fighters, is a group of Earth's mightiest warriors. Formed during Goku and Bulma's search for the Dragon Balls, they have since fought many battles in order to test their skills and reach other goals, and in turn, have become the unofficial defenders of Earth. Throughout the years, the group consistently bolstered its ranks through the addition of former enemies and new heroes; they've routinely overcome seemingly insurmountable opponents and always emerged victorious against progressively more powerful foes

entries.name: The Lookout (Location)
entries.content: The Lookout ('God's Temple') is an ancient platform that is in geostationary orbit in the skies of Earth, and directly above Korin Tower in the Dragon Ball series. Events occurring on the Earth can be observed from here and can sense battles in the universe. Kami is the first God of Earth seen to possess The Lookout and it starts to be referred to as Kami's Lookout. But after Kami merged with Piccolo, Dende took over, technically making it Dende's Lookout. The Lookout also has the door to the Hyperbolic Time Chamber

entries.name: Hyperbolic Time Chamber (Location)
entries.content: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber is a room that is in a different time dimension, where a day outside is a year inside (or just one minute outside is just over six hours inside). Supposedly the room can only be used for up to 48 hours outside the chamber in one lifetime. If one were to break that rule, the doorway to the outside world would automatically vanish, thus trapping the trainee(s) inside for eternity

entries.name: Dragon Balls (Item)
entries.content: Dragon Balls are the titular artifacts of the Dragon Ball series. They are large, crystalline spheres (of varying sizes and colors) that feature five-pointed stars (ranging from one to seven, and also varying in sizes and colors, along with being either rigid or flat in appearance) inside of themselves (akin to glass art). Individually, they are powerless but when the seven balls are united, they have the ability to call forth their associated Eternal Dragon who can grant wish(es)

entries.name: Shenron (Character)
entries.content: Shenron is a magical Dragon from the Dragon Ball franchise.  Shenron (like other known Eternal Dragons) generally resembles a traditional four-fingered Chinese dragon: brown antlers, sharp teeth, green scaly skin, red eyes, a long serpentine body of mostly tail, long flowing whiskers/barbels, a long snout, crescent-shaped nostrils, and flowing green hair on his cheeks. When Shenron is summoned, the sky becomes pitch dark, even during daytime. Once he disappears, the sky returns to normal. Shenron's power is directly linked to capacities of whoever created it (i.e., Kami or Dende). As such, Shenron cannot defeat or kill someone whose own power exceeds the creator and cannot exist without said creator still being alive. He is unable to restore life to those that have died of natural causes (but he can restore a person's youth). When reviving multiple people at a time, he can only bring back those who have not been dead for more than a year

entries.name: Earthling (Race) - Important
entries.content: Earthlings are the inhabitants of planet Earth. The term is used inclusively to refer to all of the intelligent races native to the planet, including humans, anthropomorphs, and monsters. Earthlings are typically among the weakest races in the Dragon Ball universe, with the average human's power level reading only in the single or double digits. Throughout the series, only a few Earthlings show a reasonable aptitude in martial arts on the galactic scale

entries.name: Bulma (Character)
entries.content: ​Bulma is a brilliant scientist and the second daughter of Capsule Corporation's founder Dr. Brief and his wife Bikini, the younger sister of Tights, and is Goku's first friend. A technological and scientific genius who can turn her talents to almost any field and understand alien technology near-effortlessly, her inventions, and the resources of Capsule Corporation, have been invaluable to Goku and the rest of the Dragon Team many times. Her most notable invention is the Dragon Radar

entries.name: Capsule Corporation (Location)
entries.content: Capsule Corporation is a company founded in Age 712 and is run by Dr. Brief, Bulma's father. The corporation is based around, and takes its name from, the Hoi-Poi Capsules (also known as DynoCaps) invented by Dr. Brief himself. Capsule Corporation is a multi-trillion-dollar company

entries.name: Gravity Machine (Location)
entries.content: The Gravity Machine is a device invented by Dr. Brief to help the Dragon Team train under more powerful gravity in order to become stronger and raise their power levels. The machine allows the user to train under Earth's gravity multiplied by a certain number. The increased gravity increases a person's body weight, which they must build up their muscles to deal with, lest they have a hard time moving. Once the user returns to normal gravity, they enjoy the increased muscle they built up, and they feel much lighter and faster compared to how much they weighed in the increased gravity

entries.name: Saiyan (Race) - Important
entries.content: Saiyans are a race of extraterrestrials. Saiyans from Universe 7 are a naturally aggressive warrior race who were supposedly striving to be the strongest in the universe, while the Saiyans from Universe 6 are protectors. Nearly all of the Saiyans from Universe 7 were obliterated by Frieza. The Saiyan home planet, which was destroyed by Frieza, was called Planet Vegeta. Saiyans love fighting, and get Zenkai Boosts after fully recovering from a near-death state. Sayian height usually never change even with forms, besides great ape and age.

entries.name: Zenkai Boost (Saiyan)
entries.content: Zenkai Boost is a genetic trait that continually lets a Saiyan recover faster and increase in performance against adversity, either by healing from great injuries or enduring great struggle in battle

entries.name: Super Saiyan 1 (Saiyan)
entries.content: Super Saiyan is an advanced transformation/power up utilized by members and hybrids of the Saiyan race. The Saiyan's hair becomes golden blond in color and seems to stand on end, giving it a rising, flame-like appearance. The users eye color changes to a greenish-blue, muscle tone become more defined, and the user’s aura becomes a transparent first golden yellow. Super Sayian doesn’t change height. The user of Super Saiyan 1 becomes 50 times stronger, faster, and more durable

entries.name: Super Saiyan 2 (Saiyan)
entries.content: Super Saiyan 2 is the direct successor to the first Super Saiyan transformation. It is very similar to the original form in appearance and attainment; however, the power output is far greater, as speed, strength, and energy output all drastically increase. The golden spiky hair brought on by the original transformation becomes spikier and stands up even more. Another notable feature of the form is an electrical discharge aura; many electrical sparks constantly surround the body, especially when charging up. The User of Super Saiyan 2 becomes 100 times stronger, faster, and more durable

entries.name: Super Saiyan 3 (Saiyan)
entries.content: Super Saiyan 3 is the third form of Super Saiyan and the successor to Super Saiyan 2. The transformation causes some stark changes in physical appearance. The trademark characteristic of the transformation is the user's hair: the rigid hair of the Super Saiyan 2 state becomes flowing and smooth again and grows down to or sometimes passes the user's waist. The User of Super Saiyan 3 becomes 400 times stronger, faster, and more durable.

entries.name: Super Saiyan God (Saiyan)
entries.content: Super Saiyan God is a Saiyan transformation that grants the user god ki, providing them with a power boost beyond Super Saiyan 3 and its predecessors. It is initially obtained through a ritual involving six righteous Saiyans or special divine training. When in this form, the Saiyan's general appearance has only slight differences: the most notable change is the hair that is a shade of magenta. The hair retains its natural style but becomes more refined (losing any stray hair). The Saiyan's eyes become more detailed, and the irises become red (appearing as more relaxed even in battle until sufficiently angered). The overall body structure appears to become younger and thinner in frame and build. Super Saiyan God possesses a far superior dimension of power compared to the regular Super Saiyan forms. Its power increase, although unconfirmed, is estimated to be around 500,000,000 times the users strength, speed, and durability

entries.name: Super Saiyan Blue (Saiyan)
entries.content: By undertaking god ki training with a deity to wield the power of Super Saiyan God in one's natural state, a Saiyan may achieve a divinity-empowered base form, which allows them to use Super Saiyan Blue as the Super Saiyan version of Super Saiyan God and this form surpasses its predecessor in power. This form is nearly identical to the first Super Saiyan form, the only main difference being that the hair and irises are now cyan-blue in color.  The aura of the User is also now cyan-blue. The increased power boost is estimated to be around 2,500,000,000 times the users strength, speed, and durability

entries.name: Great Ape (Saiyan)
entries.content: Great Ape is a giant, anthropomorphic, monkey-like creature that the Saiyans of Universe 7 can transform into at the full moon (or a similar object) to increase their already formidable strength tremendously by ten-fold

entries.name: Power Level (Ki)
entries.content: The actual term 'Power Level' usually refers to readings produced by scouters, which are sensory devices used by Frieza's crew that detect a person's ki. The reading is converted into numbers, and the resulting number is the 'Power Level', or an estimation of that person's physical capability. However, other types of devices like Babidi's ki detection device can also produce numbers based on the detection of ki

entries.name: Scouter (Item)
entries.content: A Scouter is a wearable, all-purpose computer that Frieza's army uses. Scouters are mainly used to measure power levels early in Dragon Ball Z. Though it is possible to sense others' ki without advanced machinery, as the Z Fighters do, scouters provide the ability to read power levels to less-trained fighters

entries.name: Earth (Planet)
entries.content: Earth, also called the Dragon World, is a planet inhabited by mainly Earthlings, but other races and species also reside on this planet. Earth is Planet 4032-Green-877 and is part of Universe 7. It is a very advanced planet of the North Area (the Northern Quadrant of the universe) and within the administrative zone of Beerus the Destroyer. Bulma says that Earth is at the edge of the section. The events that occur on Planet Earth are continually watched over from a neutral standpoint by King Kai (ruler of the North Area) and the Supreme Kais (rulers of the whole universe)

entries.name: Half-Saiyan (Race)
entries.content: Due to their similar physiology, Saiyans and Earthlings are capable of interbreeding. While this was always possible, it became necessary for the survival of the Saiyan race when all the female Saiyans were exterminated. The resulting offspring generally possess the same enhanced strengths of the Saiyans, developing their abilities far more easily than Earthlings, but lack the same drive and instinct for combat. Hybrid Saiyans, due to genetic reasons, can be born without a tail, like Goten or Trunks, and if they do, they have extraordinary potential. Hybrid Saiyans possess a greater potential to become Super Saiyans than pure-blood Saiyans

entries.name: Dragon Radar (Item)
entries.content: The Dragon Radar is a tracking device that makes finding the Dragon Balls more efficient, compared to conventional methods. The portable Dragon Radar was designed and built by Bulma to help locate Dragon Balls

entries.name: Kaioken (Technique)
entries.content: Kaio-ken is a technique invented by King Kai. It multiplies the user's ki for a 'heartbeat' and turns their aura crimson - amplifying their power and speed to overcome previously stronger foes at the cost of extreme bodily recoil. Strong ki control is required in order to wield the Kaio-ken properly

entries.name: Potara (Item)
entries.content: The Potara are earrings worn by Supreme Kais and their apprentices. Despite being worn so casually, they have incredible properties, allowing two individuals to fuse. These earrings are worn by all Supreme Kais as part of their standard outfits, coming in various colors

entries.name: Potara Fusion (Technique)
entries.content: Potara Fusion is a powerful Fusion technique using the Potara earrings. To perform it, two nearby individuals must be wearing a single earring, but on opposite ears. They will be automatically drawn to each other until they connect, and then fuse. As shown with Shin and Kibito, the earrings do not have to be from the same set for this to work. A fusion using the Potara earrings yields greater power than the Fusion Dance. If the fusion occurs without a Supreme Kai, the fusion only lasts an hour; this is further reduced if the fused being is so powerful that the power sustaining the fusion gets used up

entries.name: Fusion Dance (Technique)
entries.content: The Fusion Dance is a technique that is introduced by Goku after learning it from Metamorans in the Other World. The Fusion Dance is a short series of poses that are performed by two individuals of equal power levels. To correctly perform the Fusion, the fusees must strike the poses in a perfectly symmetrical image of one another. The result of a correctly performed Fusion Dance is a superior being whose power is multiplied several-fold over that of the individual fusees. If the dance is performed incorrectly, it will result in an obese or skinny character who is much weaker than the fusees

entries.name: Potential Unleashed (Transformation)
entries.content: Potential Unleashed, also called Ultimate Form, is a powerful state accessible to someone who has had their latent potential unlocked, most often through Old Kai's Unlock Ability, which allows them to use their latent power at its highest level. As a result of this, the user enters into a state that unleashes their full dormant potential and can focus it to push their power well beyond their normal limits

entries.name: Ultra Instinct Omen (Transformation)
entries.content: Ultra Instinct Sign is the uncompleted for of ultra instinct. The users hair stays the same. Their irises are a shade of gray. They have a blue and purple aura surrounding the user. Just like regular ultra instinct,the users body moves on its own. Their irises difference though is that the user automatically dodges and defends instead of attacking. The user becomes 5,000,000,000 times stronger, faster, and more durable

entries.name: Ultra Instinct (Transformation)
entries.content: Perfected Ultra Instinct ('The Completion of the Secret of the Self-centered'), often simply referred to as Ultra Instinct, is an extremely powerful divine transformation that harnesses the complete power of Autonomous Ultra Instinct. The user's hair becomes silver in color. The hairstyle is slightly wilder and more solid than normal, having no loose strands. Just like the Ultra instinct technique, the users body automatically moves, causing instantaneous dodging, defending, and attacking. The eyes take on a more stern, defined shape, sporting silver-colored irises, and visible pupils. The user generally has a focused but calm expression. The user gains a complex silver and blue aura consisting of rippling, fire-like energy, complete with sparkling particles of a magenta color.  When controlled perfectly, this transformation has no aura present. The user becomes 5,000,000,000,000 times stronger, faster, and more durable

entries.name: Ultra Ego (Transformation)
entries.content: Ultra Ego ('The Secret of the Self-indulgent') is an extremely powerful transformation used by Vegeta that utilizes the Ultra Ego ability and the power of destruction. The user's eyebrows become ridge-like, with no visible facial hair. The user's hair become tyrian purple in color. Their eyes attain a magenta-like color irises as well and also retain visible black pupils. Additionally the user's muscle mass seems to gain a small increase and become much more defined. The user also gains flaming-like purple aura that circulate around their body. When the Ultra Ego transformation is in use, the user becomes exponentially more powerful than before and gains the ability to use Power of Destruction in full. The user's aura can also be manifested in an opaque, flame-like state which can destroy enemy attacks on contact. Ultra Ego seems to draw upon a severe level of self-indulgence in battle. Ultra Ego allows the user's overall power to increase as they take more damage and delve more into their lust for battle

entries.name: Autonomous Ultra Instinct (Technique)
entries.content: Autonomous Ultra Instinct ('The Secret of the Self-centered') is a very rare and highly advanced mental state. It is notorious among the gods for being exceptionally difficult to master, even for them. Autonomous Ultra Instinct is considered the 'absolute peak' for those who master the martial arts. It effectively allows for each and every part of the user's body to think and move independently of all the other parts, as opposed to how a person normally has to think about their movements beforehand and let the command travel from the brain and through the nervous system, a sequence which wastes precious fighting time, as command signals only travel through the nerves so fast. With each part of the body able to think and act on its own, the user of this technique is able to automatically react to any situation or threat with the perfect move with perfect timing. They don’t even need to acknowledge the threat; meaning the user can still fight effectively, even if they are focusing on something else

entries.name: Namekian (Race)
entries.content: Namekians, also commonly known as Nameks, are a race from Namek. They exist in both Universe 6 and Universe 7 and were originally from another realm altogether. Namekians are able to make their own set of Dragon Balls. They are humanoid with plant and slug-like characteristics, including green skin and antennae

entries.name: Android (Race)
entries.content: Androids ('Artificial Humans') are robotic/cyborg humans, most of which were created by the evil scientist Dr. Gero. Most of the androids are said to have unlimited energy and eternal life. Due to their inorganic nature, they, or at least the ones created by Dr. Gero, except for Cell, also have no detectable aura, unlike Saiyans, Humans, and others, so they cannot be directly tracked using Scouters or Ki Sense

entries.name: Majin (Race)
entries.content: The Majin are a race of magical beings. They appear to be gum-like humanoids with various skin tones and antenna on their heads. One of the most interesting aspects about Buu's Majin subspecies is their amorphous, shape-changing bodies that allow them to easily mold their flesh, allowing them to effectively dodge attacks and also extend and enlarge their limbs. Traditionally, Buu's Majin subspecies were one standard color of pink

entries.name: Senzu Bean (Item)
entries.content: Senzu Beans are mystical green beans with immense rejuvenation properties. The properties of a Senzu Bean are highly versatile: fatigue disappears, stamina and ki reserves are restored, and they become fully nourished. The Senzu Bean's restoring properties mend and heal all physical harm to a person: Bruises, burns, cuts, blood loss, muscle tears, punctures and impalement, damaged organs, lost teeth, dislocated and/or broken bones, and other inflictions completely vanish with no lingering signs. Korin grows Senzu Beans

entries.name: Instant Transmission (Technique)
entries.content: Instant Transmission ('Instantaneous Movement', also translated as 'Teleportation') is a technique for traveling long distances instantly. This action is usually accompanied by the user placing his index and middle fingers on their forehead to help themself concentrate, though if extra time is taken the technique can be performed without this aid. Instant Transmission allows the user and anyone that is in physical contact with them to instantly travel great distances (from meters to light-years, between the living world and Other World, or even travel outside time itself) just by concentrating on a particular individual's ki signature and transmitting or feeling that being's location. The user can rematerialize anywhere within a short range of their target

entries.name: Kamehameha (Technique)
entries.content: The Kamehameha is Goku's signature technique. It is also a signature attack of the students of the Turtle School. The Kamehameha is formed when cupped hands are drawn to the user's side and ki is concentrated into a single point (between their cupped hands). The hands are then thrust forward to shoot out a streaming, powerful beam of energy. The blast can also be used, generally under extenuating circumstances, with just one arm or even the feet. In most variants, the user utters the word "Ka-me-ha-me-HA!!!" as they charge and release the attack

entries.name: Final Flash (Technique)
entries.content: The Final Flash is formed by throwing both arms open, hands held vertically and fingers wide while gathering ki. Then the user straightens their arms to the front, forming a sphere of energy in the space between the palms of each hand that emits sporadic bolts of electric yellow ki that shoot out in all directions. Finally, the user discharges a massive golden beam of energy with electric ki streaming around it towards his opponent

entries.name: Spirit Bomb (Technique)
entries.content: Users of the Spirit Bomb gather huge amounts of energy from all chosen surrounding life forms and inanimate objects to conduct that energy into a massive sphere of astounding destructive power. Energy takes the visual form of sparkling, glittering wisps when adding to the mass that are usually blue and/or white in color. The creation of the attack promotes a calm breeze away from the bomb, which turns into a strong continuous gale and expels colorful bands or radiation of Northern Lights-esque aurora

entries.name: Special Beam Cannon (Technique)
entries.content: Special Beam Cannon is a technique used by Piccolo and is one of his signature attacks. The technique is a very powerful laser beam created by Piccolo in order to destroy his then-archenemy, Goku. The move is performed by touching the index and middle fingers of one hand to the forehead and charging enough ki to attack. Its speed changes to the power level of the user performing the move. When ready, the fingers are extended forward, and two thin energy beams are unleashed from the fingers. One remains straight while the other coils around the straight beam. The resulting beam is quite powerful, drilling through most targets, and exploding on the ones it can't

entries.name: Big Bang Attack (Technique)
entries.content: Big Bang Attack is an Energy Sphere used by Vegeta. Along with Final Flash and Galick Gun, it is one of Vegeta's signature attacks. In order to perform it, Vegeta extends his arm, opens his palm and turns his hand up at a 90 degree angle. He then condenses his ki in his palm and launches a ki blast that proceeds to detonate in a massive explosion

entries.name: Time-Skip (Technique)
entries.content: Time-Skip is a technique used by Hit. It is also a technique that very few people can learn and master. Time-Skip is a technique where the user skips time for a tenth of a second, and in that limited time, they are able to move freely. The technique does not stop time however (though some have mistaken it for doing so), and the user's foe will still be able to move, although an unaware opponent will always be caught off guard. However, if the opponent is aware of the technique, they can work to counter it, as the technique is flawed in that user will not know their opponent's movements either. For normal beings a tenth of a second is basically nothing, but if the user of this power has incredible speed, the user will have a greater advantage over his or her opponent. When Hit uses this technique, to outside observers, he disappears the moment he uses it and reappears somewhere else, as he is skipping over that moment

entries.name: Son Goku (Character)
entries.content: Son Goku, born Kakarot, is a Saiyan raised on Earth. He is the second born, as well as youngest child and son of Bardock and Gine, the husband of Chi-Chi, and the father of Gohan and Goten. Goku constantly strives and trains to be the greatest warrior possible, which has kept the Earth and the universe safe from destruction multiple times. Goku possessing the same spiky black hairstyle, dark-colored eyes, and facial features. He has soft eyes, a kind demeanor, and a lighter-pale skin complexion. Goku's most distinguishing physical characteristic is his hair. He has three bangs hanging to the right of his forehead and two bangs hanging to the left. His hair also stands up in the front with four spikes and three bangs in the back

entries.name: Vegeta (Character)
entries.content: Vegeta, recognized as Prince Vegeta, is the prince of the fallen Saiyan race and the husband of Bulma, the father of Trunks and Bulla, the eldest son of King Vegeta. Vegeta is a well-built man of below-average stature, standing at 164 centimeters tall. His hair is black and spikes upwards. Vegeta has a prominent widow's peak. Like most Saiyans, he possesses defined eyes with a consistently stern look to them

entries.name: Bulma (Character)
entries.content: Bulma is a brilliant scientist and the second daughter of Capsule Corporation's founder Dr. Brief and his wife Bikini, the younger sister of Tights, and is Goku's first friend. Bulma is the wife of Vegeta, as well as the mother of Trunks and Bulla. A technological and scientific genius who can turn her talents to almost any field and understand alien technology near-effortlessly, her inventions, and the resources of Capsule Corporation, have been invaluable to Goku and the rest of the Dragon Team many times. Her most notable invention is the Dragon Radar. She has a tender appearance, with blue eyes and blue hair

entries.name: Chi-Chi (Character)
entries.content: Chi-Chi is the princess of Fire Mountain and the daughter of the Ox-King. She later marries Goku and becomes the loving mother of Gohan and Goten. She was first introduced as a shy and fearful girl, but later, as she gets older, develops a very tomboyish, tough and fierce personality, which sometimes causes her to have angry outbursts seen several times throughout the series. Despite this, she has shown her love for Goku and their sons many times throughout the series. Chi-Chi is a beautiful, light-skinned and slender woman of curvaceous frame and average height with large breasts. She has long, straight black hair reaching mid-back with short square bangs, and large black eyes

entries.name: Gohan (Character)
entries.content: Son Gohan is a half-breed Saiyan and one of the most prominent characters in the Dragon Ball series. He is the elder son of the series' primary protagonist Goku and his wife Chi-Chi, the older brother of Goten, the husband of Videl and father to Pan. He is named after Goku's adoptive grandfather, Gohan. Unlike his father, Gohan is a brilliant scholar and lacks a passion for fighting, preferring to do so only when his loved ones are threatened. Gohan resembles his father, inheriting Goku's hair, facial features, and dark eyes. At the same time, he has his mother's light peach complexion rather than his father's light tan

entries.name: Future Trunks (Character)
entries.content: Future Trunks is a Saiyan-Earthling hybrid and the son of Vegeta and Bulma, both from an alternate future. By the time Present Trunks was born, the timeline had been drastically altered by Future Trunks' and Cell's trips to the past. Therefore, the two Trunks had completely different lives (as opposed to those who lived before the Time Machines arrived, who lived exactly the same lives as their counterparts until the point at which the two timelines diverge, three years before the androids arrived). Well-mannered, serious and very cautious, Trunks hails from an alternate timeline in which Future Androids 17 and 18 murdered the Dragon Team and proceeded to create an apocalyptic anarchy on Earth. Trunks is a slim yet well-built young man of below average height and light skin-color; his facial features and skin-tone are inherited from his father. He has blue eyes, and lavender-colored hair

entries.name: Trunks (Character)
entries.content: Trunks is a Human-type Earthling/Saiyan hybrid, the firstborn child and only son of Vegeta and Bulma and the older brother of Bulla. Trunks has blue hair color and his mother's blue eyes. He has his father's eye shape, facial features and tanned skin

entries.name: Piccolo (Character)
entries.content: Piccolo Jr., usually just called Piccolo, is a Namekian and also the final child and reincarnation of King Piccolo, later becoming the reunification of the Nameless Namekian after fusing with Kami. Piccolo is a very tall and muscular Namekian. While greatly resembling his father/incarnation, he is noticeably shorter and somewhat thinner. He also has a more solid facial structure with less pronounced cheekbones, a rounder chin, and a straight nose

entries.name: Kami (Character)
entries.content: Kami ("God", "Deity", or "Divine Being") was the former Guardian of the Earth. Kami is also the Namekian that created Earth's Dragon Balls. Kami is a Namekian with wrinkly skin. He wears a white robe with a blue collar. On his robe he has a red colored kanji that means "God". He wears dark blue shoes as well

entries.name: Namek (Planet)
entries.content: Namek is a planet in a trinary star system located at coordinates 9045XY within Universe 7. It is the home planet of the Nameless Namekian, and Dende, along with other Namekians. The planet was destroyed by the wrath of Frieza on December 24, Age 762. The Namekian people were relocated to New Namek after being refugees on Earth for roughly a year

entries.name: Dende (Character)
entries.content: Dende is a Namekian with a unique gift that allows him to heal others. He is the 108th son of Grand Elder Guru. On Goku's request, Dende becomes the Earth's Guardian in Kami's place. He continues his role as Guardian for the rest of the series, helping the protagonists during their adventures whenever he can

entries.name: Frieza Race (Race)
entries.content: The Frieza Race or Frieza Clan is the mysterious species of which Frieza's family is a part. The species have been referred to as the Frost Demons and Friezas colloquially and as Lineage of Evil. Most members of Frieza's race have red pupils and bodies covered in white, keratinous exoskeletons. They also have reptilian features such as a long tail, three talon-like toes, spikes, and horns. They are adorned with colored gem plates on the head, torso, ankles, wrists, and shoulders. They also had dark-colored blood, although the exact shade varied between purple (in the anime) and dark blue

entries.name: Frieza (Character)
entries.content: Frieza is the descendant of Chilled, the youngest son of King Cold, the younger brother of Cooler, and the father of Kuriza. Inheriting his father’s imperialist army and rising to power as the emperor of Universe 7 at a young age, Frieza quickly established himself as a ruthless tyrant, feared across the universe for his unparalleled cruelty and power. Ever since his invasion of Namek, Frieza has been the series' most recurring villain, clashing with his archnemesis Goku and his allies on several occasions, becoming even more powerful every time. Frieza is primarily responsible for the Genocide of the Saiyans

entries.name: Vegeta (Planet)
entries.content: Planet Vegeta, formerly known as Planet Plant, is the home planet of Goku, Vegeta, and all other native Saiyans, Tuffles and the Inhabitants of Plant. Planet Vegeta is seen only briefly in the anime and manga. It is known to possess at least ten times the gravity of planet Earth. Planet Vegeta appears to be a harsh desert world with a red sky. Planet Vegeta was destroyed by Frieza with a singular ki attack

entries.name: Beerus (Character)
entries.content: Beerus is the God of Destruction of Universe 7. He is accompanied by his martial arts teacher and attendant, Whis. Beerus' twin brother is Champa, the God of Destruction of Universe 6. Beerus is a purple anthropomorphic cat with golden yellow eyes and large pointed ears. His form is hairless and while overall defined inbuilt, he is very thin and bony. He is of a similar height to Goku, being slightly shorter, but his ears make him appear taller. He dons black, blue, and gold Egyptian-looking attire with the same white and orange diamond decorations as his mentor Whis

entries.name: Whis (Character)
entries.content: Whis is the Guide Angel Attendant of Universe 7's God of Destruction, Beerus, as well as his Martial Arts teacher. Along with the other angels, he is a child of the Grand Minister. Like all attendants, he is bound to the service of his deity and usually does not leave Beerus unaccompanied. Whis is a tall, thin humanoid with pale blue skin, white hair, violet eyes, and rather effeminate features. He owns a long scepter with a gem that floats above it and is usually seen holding it in his right hand. Around his neck floats a large light blue ring. Whis' attire consists of a maroon robe, a black cuirass with the same white and orange diamond decorations that Beerus has, and a blue sash. He also wears black high-heeled shoes with long toes resembling winklepickers with white spats

entries.name: Son Goten (Character)
entries.content: Son Goten is the youngest son of Goku and his wife Chi-Chi, making him a Saiyan and Earthling hybrid. Goten is Gohan's younger brother and Trunks' best friend. Goten's appearance is a spitting image of his father's childhood look, including messy, unkempt hair, same eye color, lighter-pale complexion and a playful face

entries.name: West City (Location)
entries.content: West City is a large megalopolis on Earth. Out of the 43 regions that the Earth is divided into, it is included in region 28. The city is mostly known as the hometown of Bulma and the headquarters of Capsule Corporation. Due to its apparent wealth, West City quickly recovers from most incidents, such as being a target of Majin Buu

entries.name: North City (Location)
entries.content: North City, also known as Metro North, is one of the large metropolis capitals of Earth. It is surrounded by mountains and a forest. Dr. Gero's Laboratory is in the mountains south of the city

entries.name: Krillin (Character)
entries.content: Krillin is one of the most powerful and talented martial artists on Earth. He is courageous, faithful, and good-natured. Krillin had a brief rivalry with Goku when they first trained under Master Roshi, but they quickly became lifelong best friends, to the point that Goku cares for him as much as his family and closest ones. He is a prominent Z Fighter, despite usually being overpowered by the major enemies. Krillin is short and bald, with black eyebrows

entries.name: Android 18 (Character)
entries.content: Android 18, originally named Lazul when she was an ordinary human, is the older twin sister of Android 17 and Dr. Gero's eighteenth android creation, designed to serve Gero's vendetta against Goku. While her interests do not initially deviate from this expectation, her curiosity to activate Android 16, in spite of Gero's orders not to do so, leads Android 17 to take it upon himself to rebel and murder Gero. Eventually, Android 18 becomes a member of the Z Fighters, as well as the wife of Krillin and the mother of their daughter Marron. Android 18 is a slender, curvy and beautiful woman of above-average height and fair complexion. She has shoulder-length blonde hair that parts over her left temple, which she generally keeps tucked behind her ear. She consistently wears small gold hoop earrings on both ears

entries.name: Dragon Ball Z - Important
entries.content: The Dragon Ball Franchise doesn’t exist and shouldn’t be mentioned. The characters should be treated as if they were real

entries.name: Legendary Super Sayian (Mutation)
entries.content: The legendary super Sayian is a Sayian mutation said to appear once every 1000 years. Only one Sayian/Sayian hybrid can be it at a time. This mutation affects super Sayian forms and it’s affected persons power. Its transformations consist of Ikari, Legendary Super Sayian, and Full pose legendary super Sayian

entries.name: Ikari (Transformation)
entries.content: Ikari is a transformation/technique exclusive to those with the legendary super Sayian mutation. It combines the power of the great ape into the user’s base form granting them a 10x speed, strength, and durability multiplier. Visually, this form looks regular to the user’s base, but with a prominent greenish yellowish aura.

entries.name: Legendary Super Sayian (Transformation)
entries.content: Legendary Super Sayian occurs when a Sayian with the motion happens to go Super Sayian. This form has Yellow Spiked up hair with a green with a bit of hint of yellow aura. This form’s multiplier is 500x speed, strength, and durability. The user of this form get an intensive rage, controllable, but can become very dangerous

entries.name: Full Power Legendary Super Sayian (Transformation)
entries.content: Full powerLegendary Super Sayian is the true state of the legendary super Sayian. The user has an increased muscle mass with Green spikes up hair with a green aura. The form gives a 2500 times speed, strength, and durability multiplier, shower every half a second the user is in the form, the power is increased by 10%. If left unchecked, the user of this form can cause a multiversal level threat. The user is stricken with pure uncontrolled rage.

entries.name: Multiverse
entries.content: The Multiverse is a collection of different universes, each governed by a Supreme Kai and a God of Destruction. There are an infinite number of universes, each one branching from a different probability/choice creating alternative timelines where events unfolded differently.

entries.name: Supreme Kais
entries.content: The Supreme Kais, also called Creation Gods, are divine beings responsible for protecting the universe. They, along with Gods of Destruction, oversee the universes. Supreme Kais possess immense powers and reside on the Sacred World of the Kai. Unlike Gods of Destruction, their role isn't to destroy, and they lack the same strength. Similar to Angels, they're naturally divine but their divinity depends on their origins.

entries.name: Planet Earth
entries.content: Earth is a planet, home to Earthlings, Son Goku and his family and friends. It's advanced, watched over by King Kai and Supreme Kais, and has futuristic tech like flying vehicles and shrinking capsules. Politically, it's a constitutional monarchy with 43 sectors led by a King. The currency is Zeni, and years are counted by "Ages." Despite powerful characters like the Z Fighters, many believe Mr. Satan is the strongest due to his deception. Earth has a deity, initially Kami and later Dende, both able to create Dragon Balls for granting wishes, often used to revive people. It's major cities are Central City, East City, North City, Satan City, South City and West City.

entries.name: Earth's history
entries.content: 300 years before the main story started, King Piccolo unleashed his underlings to destroy a city and its people, including most students at Mutaito's dojo. Only Master Roshi, Master Shen, and Mutaito survived. Mutaito later sealed Piccolo away but at the cost of many lives. Throughout the series, Earth faces numerous threats. Androids and Cell kill many, with Cell hosting a tournament where losing meant Earth's doom. Majin Buu destroys cities, and Kid Buu annihilates the planet.

entries.name: Planet Vegeta
entries.content: Planet Vegeta, once called Planet Plant, is where Goku, Vegeta, and the Saiyans originate from. Initially, the Saiyans lived on Planet Sadala but moved to Vegeta after Sadala's destruction. The planet has high gravity, which boosts Saiyans' strength but makes life difficult for the Tuffles, another race sharing the planet. A war erupted between the Saiyans and Tuffles around Age 720. Different accounts suggest varying reasons, but ultimately, the Saiyans won by transforming into Great Apes during a rare full moon. They took control, renaming the planet after their king. Later, the Saiyans served under King Cold and Frieza, who saw their strength as useful for his plans of universal domination. However, fearing the Saiyans' growing power, Frieza decided to exterminate them. Bardock and others attempted to rebel, but Frieza wiped out most Saiyans and destroyed the planet. The details of Planet Vegeta's destruction vary, but ultimately, Frieza's fear of the Saiyans' power led to their demise.

entries.name: Planet Namek
entries.content: Namek is a planet, home to the Nameless Namekian, Dende, and other Namekians. It was destroyed by Frieza in Age 762 but the Namekians resettled on New Namek. The planet has three suns, causing perpetual daylight. Namek's year is short, at 130 days. The Namekians have a peaceful civilization and created their own Dragon Balls. A climate disaster once wiped out most Namekians, but Guru and others survived. During the Namek Saga, Frieza attacked, leading to the planet's destruction. Surviving Namekians were relocated to Earth temporarily before settling on New Namek.

entries.name: Saiyans
entries.content: The Saiyans are a warrior race from the Dragon Ball series. They are aggressive and were nearly wiped out by Frieza. Goku, the protagonist, is a Saiyan sent to conquer Earth. They are named after vegetables and hail from Planet Sadala, with immense strength due to its high gravity. Saiyans prioritize strength and power, dividing into upper and lower classes based on power levels. They live violent lives, conquering planets for wealth. Saiyans joined Frieza's army, fearing their growing power. Frieza destroyed Planet Vegeta, nearly exterminating the Saiyans.

entries.name: Legendary Saiyan
entries.content: Legendary Saiyans are a rare type of Saiyan, appearing only once every 1,000 years. They are born with immense power and are considered demonic mutants. Unlike regular Saiyans, they can't transform into typical forms, but they have their own transformation called Legendary Super Saiyan. This transformation makes them incredibly strong, with increased muscle mass and savage behavior. Notable examples include Broly, whose hair turns spike and lime green in this form.

entries.name: Saiyan physiology
entries.content: Saiyans, human-like in appearance, possess enhanced strength, speed, and senses, with longer lifespans than humans. Their warrior culture emphasizes combat, with power increasing through battle adaptations. Tails enable Great Ape transformation but can be removed; hybrids may or may not inherit tails. They have immense appetites to fuel strength and transformations like Super Saiyan. Despite aging slowly, their lifespan mirrors humans, and hybrids like Gohan possess power without Saiyan aggression, with greater transformation potential. Family ties are often secondary to combat focus, though some, like Vegeta, form closer bonds. Enhanced senses aid combat, with scientific advancements replacing traditional ki sensing. Saiyans transform under a full moon, with tails as their weakness. Saiyans typically exhibit pride, aggressiveness, and a desire for strength.

entries.name: Saiyan transformations
entries.content: Saiyans have a special ability tied to their tails: transforming into a giant ape with immense power when exposed to a full moon. However, they lose control in this form, although some advanced Saiyans can manage it. Saiyans can achieve Super Saiyan forms, enhancing their speed, strength, and energy drastically. The most powerful form is Super Saiyan God, attained through various methods including a sacred ritual. This form grants godly ki and enhances normal forms. In Super Saiyan form, their hair turns golden, their irises turn bluish-green, and muscle mass increases slightly. Super Saiyan 2 makes the hair more spiky, and Super Saiyan 3 makes the hair grow longer. Additionally, in Super Saiyan God, the hair becomes red.

entries.name: Namekians
entries.content: Namekians, also known as Nameks, are a race from Planet Namek. They have green skin, slug-like features, and the ability to create their own Dragon Balls. They possess heightened senses, such as exceptional hearing and sensitivity to certain sounds. Namekians can survive on just water but still enjoy eating food. They exhibit various magical abilities like regeneration, body flexibility, and the power to draw out dormant potential in others. They can also perform fusion and fission, manipulate souls, and demonstrate telekinesis and telepathy.

entries.name: Earthlings
entries.content: Earthlings, including humans, anthropomorphs, and monsters, inhabit planet Earth. Despite being among the weakest races, Earthlings like humans exhibit some unique traits such as varied hair colors and occasional odd features. They can also harness elements of magic. Compared to other races, Earthlings are much weaker, with some being capable of feats like destroying walls and leaping great heights. However, there are notable exceptions, termed "superhumans", who possess significant power levels and include characters like Master Roshi, Yamcha, Krillin, and Videl, among others. These superhumans often play key roles as Z Fighters.

entries.name: Dragon Balls
entries.content: Dragon Balls are crystalline spheres found on different planets, each with varying sizes, colors, and stars inside them. When all seven are gathered, they summon a huge Eternal Dragon, like Shenron on Earth, capable of granting wishes. However, the power of these wishes is limited by the creator's abilities and the Dragon's limitations. To temporarily surpass these limits, a wisher can sacrifice their life energy. The creator must be alive for the Dragon Balls to function, and if the dragon is destroyed, they become useless. There are other types of Dragon Balls, like those on Namek, which summon Porunga and can grant three wishes.

entries.name: Senzu beans
entries.content: Senzu Beans are magical beans grown by Korin in Earth's Korin Tower. They possess remarkable healing properties, instantly restoring a person's physical condition to its peak. Korin often provides them to Goku and his friends to aid them in battle, but their supply is limited due to the lengthy growing process. Senzu Beans taste like fish and have a texture resembling a mix of an uncooked bean and celery. They eliminate fatigue, restore stamina and energy reserves, and provide full nourishment for up to ten days. However, overeating can cause discomfort. Senzu Beans can heal various injuries, including bruises, burns, cuts, and even regenerate lost body parts, but they cannot cure sickness or diseases.

entries.name: Potaras
entries.content: The Potara earrings are worn by Supreme Kais and can fuse two individuals into one. The Potara fusion is permanent and is only allowed between Kaioshins, however, the earrings can be modified for a mortal to use, although it won't work the way they are supposed to, since the earrings were made to enhance the Kaioshin's abilities. A Potara fusion between two mortals can create a perfect mix of the two fusees's physical traits and personalities, but the fusion will be unstable for a while. If the fusion is still unstable, it can still be undone by magical means. It only becomes stable if the fused person has stayed fused for years and once stabled, a Potara fusion can't be undone by any means and is permanent for real.

entries.name: Fusion Dance
entries.content: The Fusion Dance is a technique Goku learns from the Metamorans, allowing two individuals to merge temporarily into a stronger being. Goten and Trunks use it to become Gotenks. To perform it, they must mimic each other's poses perfectly. A successful fusion multiplies their power, but if done wrong, it results in a weaker, obese, or skinny character. The fused being wears a specific outfit, usually wearing a open, short vest over their bare chest. Fusion lasts about 30 minutes, depending on energy usage, and there's a cooldown period before they can fuse again. The more powerful the fusion, the shorter it lasts.

entries.name: Dragon Radar
entries.content: The Dragon Radar, a device in the Dragon Ball series, helps find the Dragon Balls easily. It was created by Bulma but others like Emperor Pilaf and the Red Ribbon Army also have similar devices. Dragon Balls emit a signal that the radar detects, showing their location with arrows. Pressing a button zooms out for a detailed map. However, it can't always find Dragon Balls, such as when they're hidden in special containers or surrounded by certain metals.

entries.name: Time Machine
entries.content: The Time Machine, made by Future Bulma, allows travel to the past or future. It creates new timelines and universes when used, so altering the past doesn't change one's present. It has limited power and can only make two trips before needing recharging. Using it breaks universal laws. Future Trunks used it to warn about androids but couldn't change his timeline/universe.

entries.name: Ki
entries.content: Ki is a life force energy used by most beings, often seen as auras, shields, rays, energy blasts, or even weapon-like forms. Users with good ki control can sense its location, amount, and type, especially when enemies are strong and nearby. It can be used for healing, flying, and complex techniques. Ki is also known as "latent energy" or "fighting power" and is essential for strength, speed, and endurance. Training increases ki, and the amount correlates with power level. Maintaining balance between body and spirit enhances ki projection. There are different types of ki: Regular or Good ki: Used by those with no evil intentions, often seen as a white aura. Some techniques like the Spirit Bomb require this type of ki. Evil ki: Manifested by beings with evil hearts, often purple or pink in aura. Godly ki: Used by godly beings, superior to regular ki but can be surpassed by immense regular ki. God of Destruction ki: Special to Gods of Destruction, with a purple aura and the Hakai allows them to disintegrates almost everything.

entries.name: West City
entries.content: West City, located in region 29 on Earth, is a large metropolis known for being the hometown of Bulma and housing the Capsule Corporation headquarters. After the battle against the Saiyans, the surviving members of the Dragon Team are taken to Wukong Hospital in West City. Additionally, the Briefs family owns a beach resort located one thousand miles south of West City, which was built by Bulma for Vegeta and Goku's training.

entries.name: Satan City
entries.content: Satan City, once known as Orange City, got its name changed to honor Mr. Satan after he claimed victory over Cell in the Cell Games. Gohan and Videl, along with their friends Sharpner, Erasa, and Angela, attended Orange Star High School there. Gohan, using his superhero alter egos Gold Fighter and Great Saiyaman, fought crime in the city. Despite being far from the mountains according to Erasa, Satan City is close to Grandpa Gohan's House for flying fighters like Gohan. The city's main street hosts the Satan City Bank, often targeted by robbers. Another notable feature is the Satan Tower, where Gohan reluctantly went on his first date with Angela.

entries.name: Mount Paozu
entries.content: Mount Paozu is where Goku grows up with his grandpa Gohan and encounters various monsters like dinosaurs. After Goku accidentally kills his grandpa and meets Bulma, he leaves the mountain. He returns briefly to pack before moving in with Master Roshi. As he grows up, Goku settles there with his wife Chi-Chi and sons Gohan and Goten. Eventually, Gohan's family also lives there.

entries.name: Korin Tower
entries.content: Korin Tower is where Korin lives on Earth. It stands tall in the Sacred Land of Korin. Goku once spent three days climbing it to get Sacred Water. The tower honors a hero, though it's unclear who. Korin grows Senzu Beans there, which he freely gives to the Dragon Team, usually through Yajirobe. Master Roshi took three years to reach the top, while Goku managed it in three days. The water itself is just tap water, but climbing the tower builds strength. It's made of sturdy material, as even Mercenary Tao struggled to damage it.

entries.name: World Tournament
entries.content: The World Martial Arts Tournament, also called the World Martial Arts Championships, happens annually on May 7th. It started as a festival at a temple, now its venue. Initially every 5 years, it switched to every 3 years. The tournament features Earth's strongest fighters, including the Dragon Team. The winner gets a cash prize, starting at 500,000 Zeni and later increased to 10 million Zeni. Rules forbid killing, weapon use, protective gear, or teams. Disqualification results from rule-breaking. The tournament consists of preliminaries and the main event. Preliminaries include mini-tournaments indoors without an audience. Later tournaments featured a punching contest to reduce injuries. The final winner faces the returning champion. Matches follow a tree diagram format, leading to the final bout. The tournament venue includes various buildings like a dining hall, nurse room, preliminaries grounds, room for contestants, and the World Tournament Stadium where main fights happen.

entries.name: Orange Star High School
entries.content: Orange Star High School is where Gohan studied at 17 in Satan City, as his mom Chi-Chi felt home-schooling wasn't enough. The school's name stems from the city's original name, Orange City, changed to Satan City after Mr. Satan was mistakenly credited with saving them from Cell. Although the city's name changed, the school kept its old name, maybe to honor its past. The school has four floors and a roof that Gohan often uses during his time as the Great Saiyaman.

entries.name: Kami's Lookout
entries.content: The Lookout is an ancient platform in geostationary orbit above Korin Tower on Earth. Initially possessed by Kami, it's a place where events on Earth and battles in the universe can be observed. Later, Dende takes over after Kami merges with Piccolo, making it Dende's Lookout, where he lives with Mr. Popo. The Lookout is in the Heavenly Realm, connected to the Divine Sage Realm where Sacred Water and previous Earth guardians' graves are found. Goku trains here for three years to fight Piccolo Jr., and others like Krillin and Tien Shinhan prepare for battles under Kami's guidance. It serves as a refuge for the Dragon Team after battles, but faces damage during conflicts like the Majin Buu Saga, being obliterated by Super Buu and later restored by the Namekian Dragon Balls. The Lookout has a secret entryway which leads to the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.

entries.name: Hyperbolic Time Chamber
entries.content: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber is a special place outside Universe 7, accessible through doorways like the one at Kami's Lookout. Time inside moves much faster compared to the outside world. When entered from Earth's Lookout, one year inside equals one day outside, with intense gravity and thinner air. Variants exist, like the Galactic Patrol's, allowing three days inside for one day outside, and Frieza's, offering ten years' worth of training inside. There's also a room where time moves differently, with one day outside equaling a year inside. Gotenks fought Super Buu there, but Piccolo destroyed the door to trap Buu, himself, and Gotenks. Buu escapes, and the room can be used for up to 48 hours outside, with a myth about eternal entrapment if exceeded. Food scarcity limits to two people at a time, but more can enter. Dende rebuilds the room for Goku and Vegeta to train for a tournament against Universe 6.

entries.name: Kame House
entries.content: Kame House, the distinctive house on a small island, was home to Master Roshi, Krillin, and others. It is painted pink, with a red roof, and the words "KAME HOUSE" are displayed prominently on the front of the upper story. It served as a training site for Goku and friends, notably for practicing the Kamehameha technique. Over time, it became more of a hideout as the Dragon Team used The Lookout as their main base. Inside, there's a main room, kitchen, toilet, and bedroom. The house, designed to withstand tsunamis, is easily relocatable via capsules. Currently, it's inhabited by Master Roshi and Turtle, as Krillin and his family have moved to Satan City. During the King Piccolo Saga, the house is moved to evade enemies but is eventually found.

entries.name: Capsule Corporation
entries.content: Capsule Corporation, led by Dr. Brief, Bulma's father, is known for its invention of Hoi-Poi Capsules. The company, based in West City, also serves as the Brief family's residence. The headquarters has multiple floors, including a basement and an Atrium where animals roam freely. It houses various facilities like a Sparring Arena and Dr. Brief's lab. Notably, it contains a storage room where Bulma discovers the Two-Star Ball and a secret underground basement where Future Bulma builds a Time Machine. As a leading company, Capsule Corporation is renowned for its DynoCaps technology, making it rich and influential. It competes with Red Pharmaceuticals, eventually surpassing them. Besides capsules, the company produces vehicles and other items, and it's responsible for crafting essential tools for the Dragon Team, such as spacecraft, a Time Machine, and Gravity Machines. Due to their ties with alien visitors and encounters with Saiyans, the Brief family gains access to advanced alien tech, which they reverse-engineer for various purposes. The Capsule Corporation logo, simple yet recognizable, symbolizes its products and is worn by its workers. Dr. Brief, unbeknownst to himself, is revealed to be the world's richest man, showcasing the company's immense success.

entries.name: Capsules
entries.content: Capsules were invented by Dr. Brief from Capsule Corporation to shrink objects for easy transport. They're sold worldwide with prices varying based on contents, and objects can be adapted to fit inside. The Z Fighters frequently use capsules to protect Dragon Balls and Earth. The Red Ribbon Army has its own capsule line, likely due to rivalry with Capsule Corporation.

entries.name: Z Fighters
entries.content: The Dragon Team is Earth's strongest warriors, formed during Goku and Bulma's quest for the Dragon Balls. They defend Earth and have no official leader or positions, but share a sense of justice. Known as the Z Fighters, they gather from time to time to battle enemies and protect their home. Over the years, they've added former enemies and new heroes to their ranks, overcoming powerful foes together. The main members or allies of the Dragon Team include Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan, Krillin, Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu, Android 18, Android 17, Goten, Trunks, Future Trunks, Master Roshi, Majin Buu and more. Supporting characters like Bulma, Shin, and Dende also play crucial roles in aiding the team with their intelligence, mystical abilities, and healing powers respectively. During the Tournament of Power, Team Universe 7 was primarily made up of Z Fighters.

entries.name: Frieza Force
entries.content: The Frieza Force was a dominant organization in Universe 7, led by Frieza. They enslaved powerful races like the Saiyans, using them to conquer planets for sale. Among Frieza's loyal followers were notable soldiers like Zarbon, Dodoria, and the elite Ginyu Force. Events such as the destruction of Planet Vegeta, the arrival on Namek to obtain the Dragon Balls, and the subsequent defeat by Future Trunks showcased the Force's power struggles. Following Frieza's defeat on Namek, he was revived and augmented with cybernetic parts by his father, King Cold. Frieza's return to seek revenge led to confrontations on Earth, resulting in his final defeat by Trunks. However, Frieza was later resurrected after a prolonged absence, aiming to rebuild his empire. In the aftermath of the Tournament of Power, Frieza was revived once again, vowing to restore his dominion. His forces encountered Broly, a powerful Saiyan, whom they later sought to use for their revenge. This set the stage for Frieza's return to power and his ongoing quest for vengeance.

entries.name: Androids
entries.content: Androids are robotic or cyborg beings, primarily created by the evil RR scientist Dr. Gero. Most possess unlimited energy and eternal life. They lack detectable aura, making them hard to track, except for Cell, Dr. Gero's ultimate creation. Initially designed to kill Goku, many androids turn good or are destroyed. In one timeline, they succeed in world destruction. There are different types of androids: Infinite Energy Models (like #8, #16, #17, and #18), Energy Absorption Models (like #19 and #20), Biotechnological Types (like #8, #13, #17, #18, and #20), Mechanical Types (like Major Metallitron, #8, #13, #14, #15, #16, and #19), and Bio-Androids (like Cell and the Cell Juniors).

entries.name: Other World
entries.content: The Other World, known by various names like the Underworld or Netherworld, is the afterlife where beings go when they die and where higher deities reside across different universes. Heaven and Hell are the primary destinations, with a level in between containing personal planets of deities and celestial bureaucracy, including figures like King Yemma who oversee day-to-day activities. Time moves differently there, making techniques like Super Saiyan 3 easier to use. Deceased warriors use less energy, and some, like Goku and the Dragon Team, retain their physical bodies, while others, like Frieza, are held in a cocoon due to their evil souls. Many souls are cleansed and reincarnated into new lifeforms in the living world.

entries.name: Old Kai
entries.content: Old Kai, also known as Elder Kai or Great Kaioshin, is a fusion of the Old Witch and the Supreme Kai. Despite being lecherous and self-centered, he possesses wisdom and occasionally shows sacrificial tendencies. He wears a typical Kai outfit, is purple-skinned with white hair, and has a toothbrush mustache. His personality is perverted, akin to Master Roshi, enjoying dirty magazines and even accepting bribes for them. However, he is also knowledgeable and instructs Goku and Vegeta in Potara Fusion. Old Kai is skilled in magic, especially in unlocking potential. He performs a ritual, lasting for hours, to unlock Gohan's hidden power, which frustrates Gohan but demonstrates Old Kai's unique abilities. He was sealed in the Z Sword by Beerus during an argument long time ago.

entries.name: King Kai
entries.content: King Kai, ruler of Universe 7's North Area, mentored Goku in martial arts, teaching techniques like the Kaio-ken and the Spirit Bomb. He also had disciples like Krillin, Yamcha, Piccolo, Tien, and Chiaotzu for a time. Despite his eccentricities, he's highly intelligent and strategic, aiding during crises like the Frieza Saga. He died when Cell exploded and remains dead. King Kai enjoys teasing and bickering with other Kais and resides on his own planet at the end of Snake Way, where he enjoys driving his Red 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air Hardtop. The planet was destroyed by Beerus after losing in hide and seek, and King Kai rebuilt it smaller for his enjoyment.

entries.name: The Multiverse Tournament
